screening_decisions.reason: RCT of frozen shoulder randomly allocating patients to mobilisations, intra-articular steroids, ice therapy, or no treatment; includes manual therapy (mobilisation) and exercise (pendular exercises) in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Observational incidence and management study in general practice; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.
Educational article summarising textbook principles of joint mobilization; not a clinical trial.

Open RCT of frozen shoulder comparing physical therapies (therapeutic exercises, TENS, infra-red) alone versus the same plus arthrographic distension and intra-articular steroid; includes exercise intervention in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Methodological study comparing RCT protocols/registry entries with published reports; does not concern a clinical population with adhesive capsulitis.
RCT examining deep transverse friction massage (manual therapy) and capsular stretching for idiopathic adhesive capsulitis.
RCT randomly allocating frozen shoulder patients to two different exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM exercises with/without scapulothoracic exercises) in adults.
Randomised multiple-treatment trial comparing three mobilisation techniques (end-range, mid-range, mobilisation with movement) in subjects with frozen shoulder syndrome.

Comparative study of PNF movement patterns versus conventional free exercises for chronic peri-arthritis; abstract does not indicate randomisation, so study design is unclear and likely non-randomised.
Randomised pilot study (block randomization) comparing antero-posterior versus postero-anterior glide mobilization in patients with primary adhesive capsulitis.
Cross-sectional population survey of upper-limb musculoskeletal disorders; not an RCT.
Multiple-subject case report of end-range mobilization techniques; not an RCT or quasi-randomised trial.

Placebo-controlled RCT randomising adults with adhesive capsulitis to intra-articular corticosteroid plus supervised physiotherapy, corticosteroid alone, placebo plus physiotherapy, or placebo alone; includes supervised physiotherapy/exercise.
Randomised placebo-controlled trial comparing manual therapy and directed exercise versus sham ultrasound after arthrographic joint distension in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Observational study evaluating the responsiveness of the Shoulder Disability Questionnaire; not an intervention trial.
Clinical outcomes study of physical therapy and acupuncture for frozen shoulder with convenience sampling (30 PT, 30 acupuncture, 15 both); no description of randomisation.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis of frozen shoulder management; not a primary trial.
Comparative study of anterior versus posterior glide mobilisation for adhesive capsulitis; abstract does not describe randomisation, so design is uncertain.
Methodological study examining outcome reporting bias across RCTs; not a clinical trial of adhesive capsulitis.
Title refers to frozen shoulder but abstract describes a longitudinal cohort study of multiple sclerosis; mismatched indexing and not relevant.
RCT randomising patients with frozen shoulder to corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, or combination therapy; includes physiotherapy intervention in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
RCT comparing Cyriax rehabilitation (deep friction massage and mobilisation exercises) with conventional physical therapy in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Prospective observational study of the natural history of frozen shoulder; no randomised intervention comparison.
Methodological paper proposing heterogeneity statistics for meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.
Book chapter addressing reporting biases; not a primary clinical study.
Long-term prospective observational follow-up study of frozen shoulder; not an RCT.
RCT randomly assigning patients with adhesive capsulitis to passive joint mobilization plus active exercises versus active exercises alone in adults.

RCT comparing sodium hyaluronate, steroid injection, physical therapy modalities, and control; the physical therapy arm consists of modalities rather than manual therapy or exercise as defined by the review.
Electromyographic study evaluating muscle activation during therapeutic exercises; not a clinical trial of treatment effectiveness.
Comparative study of suprascapular nerve block, intra-articular corticosteroid injection and/or physiotherapy for chronic shoulder pain; population is not specifically adhesive capsulitis.

RCT randomly dividing adults with adhesive capsulitis into local steroid injection versus physical therapy measures (plus NSAIDs); physiotherapy likely encompasses exercise/manual therapy, and the trial is directly relevant.
Book chapter on interpreting results and drawing conclusions; not a primary study.
Retrospective study assessing response to injections, physiotherapy, or manipulation under anaesthetic; not an RCT.
Randomised controlled study comparing Mulligan's versus Maitland's mobilization techniques in adults with adhesive capsulitis of the shoulder.
Book chapter on presenting results and 'Summary of findings' tables; not a primary study.
Population-based observational study of consultation patterns for shoulder pain; not an RCT.
RCT comparing iodex iontophoresis and phonophoresis for shoulder periarthritis; interventions are electrotherapy modalities, not manual therapy or exercise.

Prospective randomised observer-blind trial allocating patients with painful stiff shoulder (adhesive capsulitis) to local steroid, six weeks of physiotherapy, or both; includes physiotherapy intervention.

Double-blind RCT randomising frozen shoulder subjects to electroacupuncture plus exercise, interferential electrotherapy plus exercise, or no treatment; includes supervised exercise in intervention arms.
RCT comparing combined physical therapy plus ibuprofen versus ibuprofen alone in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Randomised controlled trial of end-range mobilization techniques plus exercises/ultrasound versus exercises/ultrasound alone in chronic adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized clinical trial comparing anterior versus posterior glide mobilization (plus therapeutic ultrasound and upper-body ergometer exercise) in adults with shoulder adhesive capsulitis.
RCT of intra-articular triamcinolone and/or physiotherapy versus placebo in shoulder capsulitis; includes physiotherapy and a randomised design in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
Prospective randomised trial comparing manipulation under anaesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy for adhesive capsulitis of the shoulder.
Systematic review of conservative and surgical interventions for frozen shoulder; not a primary trial.
Book chapter on analysing data and undertaking meta-analyses; not a primary clinical study.
Randomized controlled study investigating joint mobilization versus self-exercises for limited glenohumeral joint mobility arising from adhesive capsulitis.

Prospective systematically allocated clinical trial comparing chiropractic manipulation plus exercise versus chiropractic mobilization plus exercise in adults with stage 2–3 adhesive capsulitis (quasi-randomised is eligible).
RCT comparing high-grade and low-grade mobilization techniques in adults with adhesive capsulitis of the shoulder.
Single-blinded randomised pilot study comparing home-care programme alone versus home-care plus passive joint mobilisation after corticosteroid injection in adults with adhesive capsulitis.
